units.source_text: 我总觉得柏木的这种说法是乱猜的，可我又仿效他，试图把这美的景色当做地狱来观赏。

en.t: I always felt that Kashiwagi's way of putting it was mere guesswork, but I imitated him too, trying to look at this beautiful scene as hell.
That effort was not in vain.

units.source_text: 因为在眼前一片翠绿、寂静、漫不经心的风景中，地狱确是在摇曳着。

en.t: For in the green, silent, indifferent landscape before my eyes, hell was indeed wavering.

units.source_text: 地狱似乎是不分昼夜、随时随地、随心所欲、我行我素地出现的。

en.t: Hell seemed to appear day or night, anytime and anywhere, as it pleased, following only its own will.

units.source_text: 好像我们随意呼唤，它都会立刻出现在那里似的。

en.t: It was as though, if we casually called for it, it would appear there at once.
